endpoints.title: Endpoints
endpoints.empty_description: Create an endpoint to receive events.
endpoints.create_v1_notice: New endpoints use signature v1. Use the Secret shown after creation as the sender's signing key.
endpoints.name: Name
endpoints.inbound_url_note: Prepend the current site's scheme and host to the path shown below to form the Webhook URL.
endpoints.common_headers_description: Send X-Glitter-Timestamp (Unix seconds, within ±300 seconds of server time), X-Glitter-Signature, and Idempotency-Key. Idempotency-Key is required and limited to 160 bytes. Sign with the Endpoint Secret. A v1 key must be 1–160 ASCII characters using letters, digits, period, underscore, tilde, or hyphen.
endpoints.v0_description: Set X-Glitter-Signature to sha256= followed by the lowercase 64-character hex HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp + a period (.) + the raw HTTP body. The legacy v0 verifier also accepts the hex digest without the sha256= prefix. event_id is optional; the server generates one when omitted.
endpoints.v1_description: Set X-Glitter-Signature to v1= followed by the lowercase 64-character hex HMAC-SHA256 of the input bytes below, using the Endpoint Secret. Sign the received raw body bytes; do not parse or re-serialize JSON. event_id must be a non-blank string of 1–100 characters and contain no control characters.
endpoints.v1_retries: For retries of the same event, reuse the same event_id, Idempotency-Key, and raw body. The same Endpoint, key, and body reuse the receipt; reusing a key with a different body is rejected with a 409 conflict.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.description: Route event types to HTTPS destinations.

subscriptions.signature_version_help: v0 signs timestamp + a period + the raw body. v1 signs glitter-connect-v1, timestamp, Idempotency-Key, and the raw body separated by newlines. Use v1 for new receivers. Version changes apply to newly created deliveries; existing deliveries keep their stored version.
subscriptions.signature_downgrade_warning: Changing from v1 to v0 sends with the legacy signature contract. Confirm that the receiver supports v0.
